title: mlflow traces delete --trace-ids: strip whitespace around comma-separated IDs
answers: traces delete skips trace IDs when I put a space after the comma
mlflow traces delete --trace-ids with spaces says deleted but trace still exists
why does delete_traces ignore the second trace ID in my comma list
comma-separated trace id list with spaces not deleted from experiment
body:
Symptom: Running `mlflow traces delete --trace-ids "tr-a, tr-b"` reports fewer deleted traces than requested, exits 0, and the trace after the space is still present in `traces search`.
Root cause: mlflow/cli/traces.py:delete_traces split `--trace-ids` on "," without stripping, so " tr-b" reached the tracing store with a leading space and matched nothing.
Fix pattern: Strip each comma-split entry before passing it on, e.g. `[t.strip() for t in trace_ids.split(",")] if trace_ids else None`. The same normalization already exists in `traces search --order-by` and `traces evaluate --trace-ids` (mlflow/cli/eval.py), so new comma-list CLI options should follow it.
Constraints: Applies to CLI parsing of comma-separated ID lists. `mlflow gc --run-ids/--experiment-ids` does not strip, but fails loudly on bad IDs, so it was intentionally left unchanged in this PR.
Test placement: tests/cli/test_traces.py:test_delete_command_strips_spaces_in_trace_ids mocks TracingClient and asserts the exact IDs passed as `trace_ids` to delete_traces. The older test_delete_command uses IDs without spaces and cannot catch this.
applies: CLI commands in mlflow/cli/ that accept comma-separated ID lists; not the store-level delete_traces API, which takes a list already.
says: Deleting traces using a comma-separated list with spaces fails to delete all items.
The command line trace deletion ignores identifiers that have a space after the comma.
Traces still show up after deleting them in a spaced list of identifiers.
Support spaces after commas when providing multiple trace identifiers to delete.
search: The CLI command mlflow/cli/traces.py:delete_traces must strip whitespace around each comma-separated ID in `--trace-ids` before passing them to the tracing store. Leading spaces cause store lookups to silently fail to match existing traces while exiting zero, unlike `mlflow gc` which intentionally preserves IDs to fail loudly on errors. The normalization aligns with `traces search --order-by` and `traces evaluate --trace-ids` in mlflow/cli/eval.py, and is verified in tests/cli/test_traces.py:test_delete_command_strips_spaces_in_trace_ids.
